subject.title: test: isolate process CLI tests from shared shards

question: After reconciling this branch with current `main`, should OpenClaw keep the four process-launching CLI tests in a dedicated serial forked project as the canonical CI topology?
rationale: The patch changes shared test-routing and CI-shard topology; the protected `maintainer` label requires an owner to confirm that this is the intended long-term execution boundary.

options.title: Land the isolated project
options.body: Rebase the branch, retain the canonical four-file list, and land if the refreshed routing and changed gates remain green.

options.title: Adopt a different test topology
options.body: Keep the failure evidence but replace the split with a maintainer-preferred ownership or sharding design before merge.

recommendation.title: Land the isolated project
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, retain the canonical four-file list, and land if the refreshed routing and changed gates remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: The available item evidence connects this contributor directly to the reproduced failure, proposed routing boundary, and validation artifacts.
